threshold.bound: signed compressed distribution-core ≤ 25 MB per platform
threshold.excludes: every language runtime closure (DR-119 / G14 component, not this core)

harness.measures: The signed compressed distribution-core closure that v16 names signedDistributionCore: native executable plus its mandatory runtime/data closure. Boundary is packaging, install, update, trust, management/recovery footprint. defaultInstall.excludes stay excluded.
harness.exactByteIntent: Per platform: the compressed signed artifact bytes, their sha256, declared size as a raw byte count, the D-006 numeral 25 MB with unit standing UNDECIDED, signature set, SBOM, and the published artifact list. The fixture pins those artifacts. It does not pin 26214400 as an authorized threshold.
harness.passProperty: For each of the four platforms, the pinned compressed signed closure is recorded and contains no language-runtime, analyzer, graph-engine, report-generator, evidence-database, or telemetry-backend member of defaultInstall.excludes. Size comparison to 25 MB is scored only after a D-006 unit successor. Exclusion membership is scored now.
failsIf: a language-runtime closure is counted inside the core
the published artifact list and the hashed bytes disagree
signatures or SBOM required by the inventory are absent
this specification is read as authorizing 26214400 as the D-006 bound
harness.doesNotClaim: QUALIFIED. Does not execute. Does not decide OD-101-1 or OD-101-2.

authorityClaim: Thin extraction of one harness from the independently reviewed parent. The parent is the review subject. This file exists so the D-086 promised artifactPathWhenAuthored is occupied at v2. It binds NOTHING.
